skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: City Destroyer
skins.content: Striker Series/City Destroyer. A product of Raythean Industries, this defensive gear is designed for robust combat, with additional high-density shock-absorbent elements present in the lining that answer the impact of attacks, while simultaneously tailored in parts to ensure high flexibility.
skins.quote: She will forever stand before her followers, and she will lead them forward, back to their homeland.
